fusions.name: Clicking Call
fusions.desc: A click that deals 4 resonating damage to the first enemy within 7 tiles, with a 35% chance of [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hung in Wait
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 20 dark damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roost Unmoving
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds, and you regain 12 health at once. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Wall-Clinger's Dusk
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance.
